name: Kitsune light punch
notes: F5 substitute: the medium punch cross, 13 frames at 1.5x, hit 5-6. Clip-derived 4/2/7 = C8, no deviation. Blend-out: the clip cuts with the hand at 82% reach, so blend the last 4-6 ticks to idle. Hurtbox: E5 standing body 90x360 for the whole move; sleeves are cloth, not body; only the bare striking limb gets an extra hurtbox while extended. Hitstun/blockstun are placeholders on the Ryo fixture scale (not in rules.md); damage is the C8 number (no Kitsune table exists). YOK-33: boxes re-placed from the rigged model poses on their frames (bones at 200 u/m, +pads); frame timing unchanged.
